summary: MCP server 9: phase 4, world commands and flows
author: pm
body:
`entities`, `tile_to_screen`, `walk_to`, `close_window`, `set_audio`, in-world get_state/probe keys; retarget `flows.py` and `world.py`. About 6 C++ files, ~600 lines, plus ~300 Python (derived).

**Done when:** an agent logs in, walks to a tile and reads nearby entities; reviewed.

Source: plan `.claude/design/plans/client-agent-mcp.md` (HH-0033, reviewed 2026-11-24); decisions d-027, d-028.

**Closed, 2026-11-24:** C++ committed in b2fa2e1, Python in d1a0b04. Both reviewed. Verified in world with test account htest8489: walk_to arrived/blocked/timeout and stops, tile_to_screen matches a real click, close_window works with the HUD protected, set_audio restored, journal state/net/chat events present. Through the MCP server: login, enter, walk and inventory close. Not verified: entities with rows (the map was empty) and the Linux runtime.
